turn_completion.interpretation: Exact ordinary-chance enumeration and best placement within the same player turn, evaluated by each frozen network after completing that turn. These are neural expectimax estimates, not true win-probability oracles. Includes a nonclearing TAKE control.

validation: 134 unique trials; all16 base trials matched earlier learned-prior choices/targets at256/2048. Twelve no-op immediate-placement preview controls exactly matched base. Mixture formula checked on1100 recorded decision nodes. Root preview predictions and fixed-seat orientation checked. Reusable turn-completion helper reproduced measured values.
limitations: Post-clear values and turn-completion scores are frozen-model estimates, not calibrated win-probability oracles. Preview interventions are deliberately informed by the known clearing line, proving mechanism rather than a deployable solution. Neural value under the current behavior policy need not equal optimal-play value. Four tactical seeds, seventeen selected exact controls, no new faceoffs or training.
